# T-5: Implement answered coverage review

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Implement review-draft-coverage as the post-answer stage that reads answered/dropped QA and emits only new pending questions for remaining user judgment gaps.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Stage 2 reads current draft.json, issue text, context loader output, and Stage 1 report lineage.
- Stage 2 may add pending questions only.
- Stage 2 does not update or drop answered QA.
- Stage 2 step completion requires the operator to ask or drop newly added follow-up-coverage questions.
- Stage 2 report contains the machine-readable JSON schema with findings[] and add-only actions.
- Stage 2 review command writes only draft-review-coverage.md and emits findings=<n>; operator remediation owns draft.json updates and user interaction.
- Stage 2 report actions are proposals only; parser/review command does not mutate draft.json.
- Stage 2 PASS with pending/approved follow-up QA keeps next-action on review-draft-coverage with remediation-required metadata.
- Stage 2 PASS counters and remediationRequired metadata use the defined parser contract.
- Stage 2 uses agent command id flow.draft.review.coverage.propose.
- Stage 2 completion asks final draft approval and writes draft.json.approval before gate-draft.
- Stage 2 next-action uses a stage-specific review schema rather than the generic verdict/comments schema.
- PromptBuilder does not append generic review fallback text that conflicts with Stage 2 strict JSON actions.

## Implementation Notes
Use context loader query from draft goal + answered question + answer + evidence paths. Fresh source reads are allowed only when evidence is absent or unverifiable in current prompt context. Update review next-action schema coverage for Stage 2 report shape and define the new agent command id in config.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for Stage 2 action restrictions; agent fixture proving answered QA is not negated and only additional questions are proposed.
